data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
High-cost drugs represent a significant proportion of NHS prescribing expenditure and require careful monitoring to ensure financial sustainability and clinical appropriateness. The High Cost Drugs Report at prescriber level provides detailed insights into prescribing patterns for medicines excluded from the national tariff. These drugs often involve complex commissioning arrangements and are subject to specific funding rules.

This report enables authorised users to review prescribing activity by individual prescribers, including the volume and cost of high-cost items. It supports validation of claims, monitoring of compliance with commissioning agreements, and identification of prescribing trends that may require intervention. Users can filter data by time period, drug category, and geographical area, making it a valuable tool for both local and national oversight.

The aim of this report is to promote transparency and accountability in high-cost prescribing. It helps organisations assess whether prescribing aligns with clinical guidance and funding policies, reducing unwarranted variation and improving patient outcomes. While the report provides detailed financial and prescribing data, it should be used alongside other dashboards and clinical information to inform decisions. Its intention is to support medicines optimisation and ensure that resources are used efficiently and equitably across the NHS.
